source: Cloud Brain 4h cycle — WebSearch NBA SOTA + Venn-Abers calibration

proposals.title: SC-CP: Self-Calibrating Conformal Prediction for NBA Intervals
proposals.description: Self-Calibrating Conformal Prediction (NeurIPS 2024, github: Larsvanderlaan/SelfCalibratingConformal) combines Venn-Abers calibration with conformal prediction to produce calibrated point predictions alongside finite-sample-valid prediction intervals. S22 already uses Venn-Abers fusion (fleet best 0.22073). Extending to S20 (isotonic_cpcv) would add interval-aware selection and reduce miscalibration.

proposals.title: Calibration Auto-Select (sigmoid/isotonic/none) via Brier Score
proposals.description: MDPI Uncertainty-Aware NBA Forecasting (2026) uses Brier score to automatically select calibration method (sigmoid, isotonic, or none) per model. Current islands use fixed calibration. Adding a calibration selector within the GA fitness evaluation could improve Brier by 0.001-0.003. Simple to implement: run all 3 calibration methods, pick lowest Brier on held-out validation.

proposals.title: LR-First Calibration: Logistic Regression as Baseline Calibrator
proposals.description: MDPI 2026 shows logistic regression achieves Brier 0.199 on 2024 NBA test with strict temporal split (train<=2022). LR is fast, well-calibrated, and can serve as a strong stacking meta-learner over tree outputs. Add LR as a mandatory member in the ensemble/stacking layer for S17 (ensemble) and S21 (darwinian_weights). Use LR prediction as an additional feature signal for other islands.

proposals.title: Generalized Venn-Abers (ICML 2025 Extension) for Multi-Class
proposals.description: ICML 2025 paper (arXiv 2502.05676) extends Venn-Abers beyond binary classification to generic loss functions. The current S22 venn_abers_fusion uses standard binary Venn-Abers. The ICML 2025 extension supports multi-class and regression-style objectives that better match NBA spread/totals prediction. Upgrade S22 to use the generalized formulation from the open-source implementation.

proposals.title: MC Dropout Uncertainty Ensemble for NBA Predictions
proposals.description: MDPI Uncertainty-Aware NBA Forecasting uses RNN with Monte Carlo dropout for calibrated sequential probabilities. S20 (isotonic_cpcv) focuses on calibration. Adding MC dropout to any MLP components (if GPU available) or using bootstrap aggregation as a CPU-compatible proxy would add uncertainty quantification. Use prediction variance to gate high-confidence vs pass games.
